scope: Accepted UI-only subset from docs/ui-suite/accepted-ui-resource-receipt.json, checked against disk and current art/manifest.json. Does not certify non-UI art, player animation or Unity execution.

visualReview.method: Viewed all seven existing contact sheets in this continuation; retained approved screen originals.
visualReview.finding: Consistent jade/ivory/gold frames, readable state hierarchy and aligned controls; no new layout defect observed at contact-sheet scale. Existing original-resolution reviews remain applicable because all accepted screen and preview-source hashes match.
visualReview.notRepeated: No rerendering, no new responsive or Unity execution tests, no per-screen original-resolution re-review in this continuation.

limitations: Raw icon sheets retain recorded fail/warn results; approved ownership slicing is the formal resource route. Do not equal-grid slice originals.
Native faint alpha specks remain; no cleaning or claimed new 512-pixel detail.
Model and quality remain unconfirmed wherever the native image endpoint did not disclose them.
UI acceptance uses an immutable 88-file resource receipt; the current art/manifest.json may also contain non-UI whole-game resources that this audit does not certify.
Unity import, font atlases, nine-slice rendering, actual interactions and device execution are deferred by user instruction.
